# stripe_balance (Data Source)

The account's current balance, by currency. It has no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_balance" "current" {}

output "available_usd" {
  value = [for b in data.stripe_balance.current.available : b.amount if b.currency == "usd"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `available` (Attributes List) Available funds that you can transfer or pay out automatically by Stripe or explicitly through the [Transfers API](https://docs.stripe.com/api#transfers) or [Payouts API](https://docs.stripe.com/api#payouts). You can find the available balance for each currency and payment type in the `source_types` property. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available))
- `connect_reserved` (Attributes List) Funds held due to negative balances on connected accounts where [account.controller.requirement_collection](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object#account_object-controller-requirement_collection) is `application`, which includes Custom accounts. You can find the connect reserve balance for each currency and payment type in the `source_types` property. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connect_reserved))
- `instant_available` (Attributes List) Funds that you can pay out using Instant Payouts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instant_available))
- `issuing` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issuing))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `pending` (Attributes List) Funds that aren't available in the balance yet. You can find the pending balance for each currency and each payment type in the `source_types` property. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pending))
- `refund_and_dispute_prefunding` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--refund_and_dispute_prefunding))

<a id="nestedatt--available"></a>
### Nested Schema for `available`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Balance amount.
- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
- `source_types` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available--source_types))

<a id="nestedatt--available--source_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `available.source_types`

Read-Only:

- `bank_account` (Number) Amount coming from [legacy US ACH payments](https://docs.stripe.com/ach-deprecated).
- `card` (Number) Amount coming from most payment methods, including cards as well as [non-legacy bank debits](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bank-debits).
- `fpx` (Number) Amount coming from [FPX](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx), a Malaysian payment method.
